title: Yes-man
summary: When you try to minimise conflicts and/or the number of people you’re gonna offend… When you try your best to find merits in both of the opposing sides in a (potentially controversial) discussion… When you find things you agree with in both sides of the argument… you can end up losing the ability to form opinions at all . Isn’t that scary?
content:
When you try to minimise conflicts and/or the number of people you’re gonna offend…

When you try your best to find merits in both of the opposing sides in a (potentially controversial) discussion…

When you find things you agree with in both sides of the argument…

you can end up losing the ability to form opinions at all.

Isn’t that scary?
